title: Gideon the Ninth
author: Tamsyn Muir
summary: Gideon, a sharp-tongued swordswoman stuck in a gloomy tomb-world, is dragged along as bodyguard to the necromancer she despises. They travel to a decaying mansion where the heirs of other houses must pass trials, and people start dying.
readIf: you like a snarky, skeleton-filled gothic mystery with a bold voice and a bit of everything.
skipIf: you prefer plain, linear storytelling, since the opening chapters throw a lot of invented terms at you.

pairings.reason: Another story about a clever, closed group in an isolated setting where hidden resentments lead to death.
The classic template for the mansion where guests die one by one, here crossed with bone magic.
Another dark, competitive academic fantasy with bickering rivals and magic that costs something.
